A few things
you might be wondering.

Can we start with just an idea?+

Absolutely. Share what you want to make and who it is for. We can help clarify the scope and decide what should come first.

Do you offer both design and development?+

Yes. We offer UI / UX, website, mobile app and SaaS design, alongside website development, graphic design, managed IT, networking, web hosting, digital marketing and website management. We will agree on the exact deliverables before the project begins.

How much will my project cost?+

The cards show our prices in USD. Digital marketing and website management are quoted individually after we agree on your needs. Project services are priced per project, hosting and managed IT per month, and graphic design per design, and networking per setup. Equipment, domains and third-party licences are charged separately.

Can you improve an existing website or app?+

Yes. Send us a link and tell us what is not working for you or your users. We can discuss a focused improvement or a broader redesign.

How long will my project take?+

Timing depends on scope, complexity, content readiness and feedback. We agree a project-specific schedule and review milestones in the proposal, rather than promise the same turnaround for every service.

How do payment and revisions work?+

Your proposal sets out the payment schedule, included revision rounds and deliverables. If your requirements change, we discuss the impact on scope, timing and cost before proceeding.

What do I receive at handover?+

We agree the files, documentation and account access relevant to your project before work begins. Ownership, third-party licences and any continuing costs are defined in your proposal.

Can you look after things after launch?+

Yes. Website management, hosting, managed IT and digital marketing are available as separately scoped services. We agree the tasks, service boundaries and billing for your ongoing plan.
